source_description: Create an alternative AWS infrastructure for the support-agent that is reusable across the existing Helm chart and is provisioned from scratch using OpenTofu. The Terraform/OpenTofu code must provision a VPC, an EKS cluster, the IAM roles for EKS Pod Identity, AWS Secrets Manager entries, the gp3 EBS-backed Chroma PersistentVolume, the ALB + WAFv2 + ACM ingress, the ADOT / OpenTelemetry pipeline, and a Karpenter v1 NodePool. It must reuse the existing Helm chart (deploy/helm/support-bot) without modification so the same workloads ship through both docker-compose (local) and EKS (prod).
